resolvedFinding.property: Selected roof rubble remains chargeable at ground level

remainingFindings.property: Charges remain attached to the selected current body when branching from replay
remainingFindings.problem: A charge placed on falling roof glass during interpolated replay silently attaches to a nearby slab or roof rib after branching.
remainingFindings.cause: The pointer handler selects interpolated rendered geometry, then restores the preceding resumable snapshot. The new 0.1-metre selected-body proximity check compares the displayed hit against the earlier transform and falls back to another structural body.
remainingFindings.recommendation: Carry the selected body and its local hit point across branch restore, then derive the resumed world point from that same body. Add an interpolated replay-to-charge regression.

limitations: Branch probe reproduces the native pointer handler order with exact rendered geometry; it does not synthesize a browser click.
Native UI and visual acceptance remain with the parent task.
